convention: anthropics/skills/skill-creator evals.json — trigger-only fixture per references/schemas.md. Each entry carries `should_trigger` so skill-creator's description-optimisation loop can score train/held-out trigger accuracy.
notes: Positives (should_trigger: true) target the launch + tab-routing surface of skill SKILL.md across both modes (Dynamic event-spine + Static registry browse), the wired hotkeys (incl. the Dynamic <-> Static mode toggle), and the first-screen chrome around the tabs (time-travel scrubber/rewind, filter pills, command palette, Settings, Share/export). Negatives target adjacent surfaces (re-frame2-pair drives Xray; re-frame2 authors host apps; spec discussion belongs to SKILL-REDIRECT) so the loop catches over-triggering.

evals.name: launch-default
evals.prompt: How do I open Xray in my re-frame2 dev build?

evals.name: launch-popout
evals.prompt: I want Xray on a second monitor — what's the call to pop it out into its own window?

evals.name: launch-programmatic
evals.prompt: How do I mount Xray from code? My app doesn't use shadow-cljs :preloads.

evals.name: launch-hotkey
evals.prompt: What's the Ctrl+Shift+C hotkey wired to?

evals.name: hotkey-mode-toggle
evals.prompt: Is there a keyboard shortcut to switch Xray between its Dynamic and Static modes?

evals.name: panel-route-state
evals.prompt: Which Xray panel shows me when [:cart :items] last changed in app-db?

evals.name: panel-route-machine
evals.prompt: Where in Xray do I see the current state of my checkout state machine?

evals.name: panel-route-machine-canvas
evals.prompt: Which Xray tab shows my machine's full state-chart topology, not just what happened in this one event?

evals.name: static-browse-registry
evals.prompt: Where in Xray do I see ALL my registered machines, routes, and schemas at once — not just the focused event?

evals.name: static-mode-name
evals.prompt: What is Xray's Static mode and how is it different from the normal event view?

evals.name: panel-route-schema
evals.prompt: I'm getting schema violations — which Xray panel surfaces them and when did each one start?

evals.name: panel-route-hydration
evals.prompt: My SSR hydration is mismatching — does Xray have a panel for that?

evals.name: chrome-rewind
evals.prompt: How do I go back in time in Xray — scrub through history and rewind to an earlier epoch?

evals.name: chrome-filters
evals.prompt: Some of my events are missing from the Xray list and it says 'N hidden by filters' — how do I clear the filters?

evals.name: chrome-palette
evals.prompt: What can I type into Xray's command palette when I press Cmd+K?

evals.name: neg-drive-xray
evals.prompt: Use Xray to dispatch [:cart/apply-coupon "SPRING25"] and tell me what happens.
evals.rationale: Driving Xray from a REPL is re-frame2-pair's surface, not the read-only tour.

evals.name: neg-implement-panel
evals.prompt: I want to add a new Xray panel for WebSocket connection lifecycle — walk me through the panel-facade/leaf split.
evals.rationale: Implementing Xray is out of scope; route to tools/xray/spec/.

evals.name: neg-author-app
evals.prompt: Write a re-frame2 reg-event-fx that posts a login form and dispatches :login-success / :login-failure.
evals.rationale: Authoring application code is re-frame2's job.

evals.name: neg-spec-discussion
evals.prompt: Why does re-frame2 use frames at all? What's the EP rationale?
evals.rationale: Spec / design rationale belongs to SKILL-REDIRECT.md.

evals.name: neg-setup
evals.prompt: Start me a brand-new re-frame2 project from an empty directory — deps.edn, shadow-cljs.edn, the works.

evals.name: neg-migration
evals.prompt: I've got a re-frame v1 app I want to migrate to re-frame2. Walk me through it.

evals.name: neg-implementor
evals.prompt: I'm porting re-frame2 to TypeScript. Where do I start?

evals.name: neg-vocab-only
evals.prompt: What's the difference between cause and effect in programming generally?
evals.rationale: Vocabulary hit on 'cause' without any re-frame2 context.
